findings.claim: The isSafenetEnabled check should be moved directly inside the SafenetAuditRow component instead of being handled where it currently is.
This env variable and its related logic can be removed since feature flags can now be overridden locally through the UI via the Feature flags entry in the sidebar, added in #8288.
The isLast prop on this row and the next one needs to be updated now that the Safenet audit row has been added below them.
